title: Mid-autumn in RJ's
markdown:
It's Mid-autumn festival which made me miss my family. Tbh i felt its family when i was in RJs. So i asked RJ if i can slide and watch the game together and he said `ofc my fam love u`. Im really happy.

This was monday night football, eagles @ bears, and we don't have Caleb playing for this game. Nobody thought we gonna win with a QB3 as starter.
